name: FCX vs NEM Pair Trade Strategy: Z-Score Mean Reversion
description: Pairs trading strategy on FCX (copper miner) vs NEM (gold miner). Goes long FCX when the 120-day rolling z-score of the FCX/NEM price ratio crosses below -2.0 (mean-reversion entry). Holds for 63 trading days with a -15% stop loss. Uses the HG/GC (copper-to-gold) futures ratio z-score as a macro regime indicator. Long-only strategy with 10% position sizing per trade. Event markers flag regime transitions (risk-on vs risk-off) for context.
source:
# FCX vs NEM Pair Trade Strategy — Z-Score Mean Reversion
# Entry: Long FCX when FCX/NEM ratio z-score crosses below -2.0
# Hold: 63 trading days
# Stop: -15% stop loss
# Sizing: 10% of equity per trade
# Regime context: HG/GC ratio z-score (risk-on > 0, risk-off ≤ 0)

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
nem = reference_stocks(ticker='NEM')()
fcx_close = src.c
nem_close = nem.c

# --- Copper/Gold Regime Data ---
hg_raw = common_reference_futures(ticker=ReferenceFutures.HG)()
gc_raw = common_reference_futures(ticker=ReferenceFutures.GC)()
# Use raw front-month close prices (no futures_continuation needed since
# these are reference-only for regime signal, not traded)
hg_close = ffill(hg_raw.c)
gc_close = ffill(gc_raw.c)
cu_au_ratio = hg_close / gc_close
cu_au_z = zscore(window=120)(cu_au_ratio)

# Regime classification
is_risk_on = is_valid(cu_au_z) and cu_au_z > 0.0
is_risk_off = is_valid(cu_au_z) and cu_au_z <= 0.0

# --- Price Ratio & Z-Score ---
ratio = fcx_close / nem_close
ratio_z = zscore(window=120)(ratio)

# --- Entry Signal ---
# Long FCX when z-score crosses below -2.0 (pulse signal)
long_entry = crossunder()(ratio_z, -2.0)

# --- Execution Wiring ---
# Hold for 63 trading days, long only, no short side
long_and_short_zone(hold_long=63)(long_entry=long_entry)

# Position sizing: 10% of equity per trade
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=10)

# Stop loss at -15%
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=15)

# --- Regime Transition Event Markers ---
# These are NOT trade signals — they mark when the macro regime shifts
# Detect regime transitions
regime_val = 1.0 if is_risk_on else 0.0
prev_regime = regime_val >> 1
flip_to_riskon = is_valid(prev_regime) and prev_regime == 0.0 and regime_val == 1.0
flip_to_riskoff = is_valid(prev_regime) and prev_regime == 1.0 and regime_val == 0.0

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Regime Shift: Risk-On',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Cu/Au Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='FCX/NEM Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(cu_au_z, ratio_z, flip_to_riskon)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Regime Shift: Risk-Off',
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Cu/Au Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='FCX/NEM Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(cu_au_z, ratio_z, flip_to_riskoff)
